item.title: Join Us - Valley 104.9FM Community Radio
item.description: Valley 104.9FM is a fully run by Volunteers and if you would like to join our amazing team of Volunteers, click here to submit your volunteer form. We are the only FM Radio Station that does outdoor Radio Broadcast, so come experience and or participate it by attending any of our live broadcasts during the Summer Town Festivals in the Snoqualmie Valley

item.title: Submit Public Service Announcement - Valley 104.9FM Community Radio
item.description: Valley 104.9FM accepts requests for Public Service Announcements from non-profit organizations and community groups in Duvall, Carnation, Redmond Ridge, Fall City, Snoqualmie, and North Bend. Just follow the directions and submit. Click here to read more about it and how you could submit your PSA.
